node.statement: Projection-on-range fact: if a lies in A=Im(tilde-Phi), choose x in B(H) with a=tilde-Phi(x); then tilde-Phi(a)=tilde-Phi(tilde-Phi(x))=tilde-Phi(x)=a by tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi from lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation. Thus tilde-Phi restricted to A is I_A (with the canonical inclusion into B(H) understood).
